title: Claim Payment Authorizations, Reversals and Emergency Work Reimbursement — Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties
content:
Claims finance applies these rules to every payment Bridgewell authorizes on a claim under its New Home Builder Warranties, whether for a structural repair or cash settlement, an engineer inspection, living expenses, a systems extension or appliance repair, a builder-default payment or an emergency reimbursement.

## Rules

**1. Covered determination first.** A payment is authorized only after a covered determination is on file for the claim. This is judged from the company's records of the determination on that same claim, before the payment is authorized.

**2. Emergency work.** Emergency work the homeowner had done to stop further damage to a covered defect is reimbursed up to the program's emergency repair reimbursement amount: the reimbursement is the lesser of the documented cost of the emergency work and that amount.

**3. Reversal.** An authorization is reversed in full when the work will not be performed or was authorized in error.

Each authorization carries its own authorization number and records the claim, what is paid, the documented cost and the amount Bridgewell pays. The dollars Bridgewell has committed on a warranty's claims are the total of its authorized amounts, net of reversals.

## Rule 1 at a glance

| Determination on file for the claim | Payment may be authorized under rule 1 |
|---|---|
| Covered | Yes |
| Not covered | No |
| None yet | No |

## Rule 2 worked through (hypothetical figures)

Under a program whose emergency repair reimbursement amount is 1000.00 USD:

| Documented cost of the emergency work | Lesser of the cost and 1000.00 USD | Reimbursed |
|---|---|---|
| 640.00 USD | 640.00 USD | 640.00 USD |
| 1000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD |
| 1350.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD |

## Rule 3 illustrated (hypothetical figures)

An authorization of 2400.00 USD is issued on a covered claim, and the homeowner later decides not to have the work done. The authorization is reversed in full: 2400.00 USD is reversed, and the dollars committed on the warranty's claims fall by 2400.00 USD.
